home_intro.en: This is your memory companion. Choose Play, Help, or Today.
home_intro.as: এয়া আপোনাৰ স্মৃতিৰ সংগী। প্লে, হেল্প, বা টুডে বাছনি কৰক।
home_intro.back: This is your memory partner. Select Play, Help, or Today.

rest.title.en: Do you want to rest now?
rest.title.as: আপুনি এতিয়া বিশ্ৰাম কৰিব বিচাৰে নেকি?
rest.title.back: Do you want to rest now?

play.pairs.intro.en: Let us talk about today. Choose the answer you think is correct. There is no hurry.
play.pairs.intro.as: আজিৰ বিষয়ে কথা পাতিম। আপুনি সঠিক বুলি ভবা উত্তৰটো বাছনি কৰক। কোনো ধৰণৰ দৌৰাদৌৰি নাই।
play.pairs.intro.back: Let's talk about today. Choose the answer that you think is correct. There is no rush.

play.sound.intro.en: Listen to the word, then tap the matching picture.
play.sound.intro.as: শব্দটো শুনক, তাৰ পিছত মিল খোৱা ছবিখন টিপক।
play.sound.intro.back: Listen to the sound, then tap the matching image.

play.pattern.intro.en: Tap the basket where this belongs.
play.pattern.intro.as: এইটো য'ত আছে সেই বাকচত টেপ কৰক।
play.pattern.intro.back: Tap the box where it is located.

play.step.intro.en: Put the steps of your routine in order.
play.step.intro.back: Keep the steps of your routine in order.

play.together.intro.en: Let us look at this picture together.

play.saah_pat.intro.en: Find the tea shoots with two leaves and one bud. Tap each one you see. There is no hurry.
play.saah_pat.intro.as: দুটা পাত আৰু এটা কুঁহি থকা চাহৰ ডালবোৰ বিচাৰি উলিয়াওক। আপুনি দেখা প্ৰতিটো টেপ কৰক। কোনো ধৰণৰ দৌৰাদৌৰি নাই।
play.saah_pat.intro.back: Look for tea stalks with two leaves and a bud. Tap each one you see. There is no rush.

play.apon_mukh.intro.en: Tap two cards to see the pictures. Find the two that match.
play.apon_mukh.intro.as: ছবিবোৰ চাবলৈ দুটা কাৰ্ড টেপ কৰক। মিল খোৱা দুয়োজনক বিচাৰি উলিয়াওক।
play.apon_mukh.intro.back: Tap two cards to view the images. Find two that match.

cue.reduce.en: Let us try with fewer choices.
cue.reduce.as: আমি কম বিকল্পৰ সৈতে চেষ্টা কৰো।

common.pause.en: Paused. Tap to continue, or choose Stop.
common.pause.as: থমকি ৰয়। অব্যাহত ৰাখিবলৈ টেপ কৰক, বা ষ্টপ বাছনি কৰক।
common.pause.back: Stop. Tap to continue, or select Stop.

help.stored.en: Saved on this device. It will be sent when there is a connection.
help.stored.as: এই ডিভাইচত সংৰক্ষণ কৰা হৈছে। সংযোগ থাকিলে ইয়াক প্ৰেৰণ কৰা হ'ব।
help.stored.back: Saved to this device. It will be sent if there is a connection.

help.stale_warning.en: This photo may show an old place.
help.stale_warning.as: এই ফটোখনে এটা পুৰণি ঠাই দেখুৱাব পাৰে।
help.stale_warning.back: This photo may show an old place.

remind.medicine.en: It is time for your medicine.
remind.medicine.back: Now is the time for your medicine.

remind.hydration.en: It is time for a glass of water.
remind.hydration.as: এতিয়া এক গিলাচ পানী খোৱাৰ সময়।
remind.hydration.back: Now it's time to drink a glass of water.

remind.activity.en: It is time for your daily activity.
remind.activity.back: This is the time for your daily activities.

game.gentle_end.en: That is fine. We can try again another day.
game.gentle_end.as: সেইটো ঠিকেই আছে। আমি আন এটা দিনত পুনৰ চেষ্টা কৰিব পাৰোঁ।
game.gentle_end.back: That's alright. We can try again another day.

q.today_me.part_of_day.en: What part of the day is it now?
q.today_me.part_of_day.back: What part of the day is it now?

q.today_me.weekday.en: What day of the week is it today?
q.today_me.weekday.back: What day of the week is today?

together.childhood.q.en: Tell me about the house where you lived as a child.
together.childhood.q.as: আপুনি শৈশৱত বাস কৰা ঘৰটোৰ বিষয়ে মোক কওক।
together.childhood.q.back: Tell me about the house you lived in as a child.

together.childhood.follow.as: আপোনাৰ লগত তাত কোনে বাস কৰিছিল?

together.food.q.en: What was your favourite food as a child?
together.food.q.as: শৈশৱত আপোনাৰ প্ৰিয় খাদ্য কি আছিল?
together.food.q.back: What was your favorite food as a child?

together.food.follow.en: Who used to cook it for you?

together.festivals.q.en: How did your family celebrate Bihu or a festival you love?
together.festivals.q.as: আপোনাৰ পৰিয়ালে কেনেকৈ বিহু বা আপোনাৰ প্ৰিয় উৎসৱ উদযাপন কৰিছিল?
together.festivals.q.back: How did your family celebrate Bihu or your favourite festival?

together.festivals.follow.en: What did you wear on that day?
together.festivals.follow.back: What did you wear that day?

together.music.q.en: Which song do you remember singing when you were young?
together.music.q.as: সৰু হৈ থাকোতে আপুনি কোনটো গীত গাইছিল মনত আছে?
together.music.q.back: Do you remember what song you used to sing when you were a kid?

together.music.follow.en: Can you sing a little of it?
together.music.follow.as: আপুনি ইয়াৰ পৰা অলপ গান গাব পাৰিবনে?
together.music.follow.back: Can you sing a few songs from it?

together.work.q.en: What work did you enjoy doing with your hands?
together.work.q.as: আপুনি আপোনাৰ হাতেৰে কৰা কি কাম উপভোগ কৰিছিল?
together.work.q.back: What did you enjoy doing with your hands?

together.work.follow.en: Who taught you how to do it?
together.work.follow.as: আপোনাক এইটো কেনেকৈ কৰিব লাগে কোনে শিকাইছিল?
together.work.follow.back: Who taught you how to do this?

together.places.q.en: Where is a place that made you feel happy?
together.places.q.as: আপোনাক সুখী কৰি তোলা ঠাই ক'ত আছে?
together.places.q.back: Where are the places that make you happy?

together.places.follow.en: What could you see and hear there?
together.places.follow.as: আপুনি তাত কি দেখিছিল আৰু শুনিছিল?
together.places.follow.back: What did you see and hear there?

together.tea_time.q.en: Do you like your tea with milk or without milk?
together.tea_time.q.as: আপুনি গাখীৰৰ সৈতে চাহ ভাল পায় নে গাখীৰ অবিহনে?
together.tea_time.q.back: Do you like tea with milk or without milk?

together.tea_time.follow.en: Who do you enjoy having tea with?
together.tea_time.follow.as: আপুনি কাৰ লগত চাহ খাবলৈ ভাল পায়?
together.tea_time.follow.back: With whom do you like to have tea?

together.friends.q.en: Tell me about a good friend from when you were young.
together.friends.q.as: মোক তোমাৰ সৰুৰে পৰা এজন ভাল বন্ধুৰ বিষয়ে কোৱা।
together.friends.q.back: Tell me about a good friend of yours from childhood.

q.next_step.after.back: What are you going to do next time?

q.apon_mukh.find_pairs.en: Find the two cards that match
q.apon_mukh.find_pairs.as: মিল খোৱা দুটা কাৰ্ড বিচাৰি উলিয়াওক

q.saah_pat.find_sprigs.en: Find every tea shoot like this one
q.saah_pat.find_sprigs.as: এনেধৰণৰ প্ৰতিটো চাহৰ শ্বুট বিচাৰি উলিয়াওক

q.saah_pat.left.as: চাহৰ বাকলি এতিয়াও বিচাৰি পোৱা বাকী
q.saah_pat.left.back: The tea bag is yet to be found

notice.family_pictures.as: ইয়াত আপোনাৰ পৰিয়ালৰ ফটো অন্তৰ্ভুক্ত কৰা হৈছে।
notice.family_pictures.back: This includes photos of your family.

notice.visual_mode.en: Read the word, then find its picture.
notice.visual_mode.as: শব্দটো পঢ়ক, তাৰ পিছত ইয়াৰ ছবি বিচাৰি উলিয়াওক।
notice.visual_mode.back: Read the word, then find a picture of it.

notice.routine_generic.en: A family can add their own routine in the Memory Garden.
notice.routine_generic.as: এটা পৰিয়ালে মেম'ৰী গাৰ্ডেনত তেওঁলোকৰ নিজৰ ৰুটিন যোগ দিব পাৰে।
notice.routine_generic.back: A family can add their own routine to the Memory Garden.

notice.family_photos.en: These are your family's own pictures.
notice.family_photos.back: These are your family's own photos.

notice.add_photos.en: A family can add their own photos in the Memory Garden.
notice.add_photos.as: এটা পৰিয়ালে মেম'ৰী গাৰ্ডেনত তেওঁলোকৰ নিজৰ ফটো যোগ দিব পাৰে।
notice.add_photos.back: A family can add their own photos to the Memory Garden.

next.same.en: Next time it will be the same.
next.same.back: It will be the same next time.

next.more.en: Next time it will be a little harder.
next.more.as: পৰৱৰ্তী সময়ত ই অলপ কঠিন হ'ব।
next.more.back: Next time it will be a little harder.

next.gentler.en: Next time it will be a little easier.
next.gentler.as: পৰৱৰ্তী সময়ত এয়া অলপ সহজ হ'ব।
next.gentler.back: This will be a little easier in the future.

next.with_help.en: Next time there will be some help.
next.with_help.back: There will be some help in the future.

together.who.en: Who is here? What do you remember about this?
together.who.as: ইয়াত কে আছে? এই বিষয়ে আপোনাৰ কি মনত আছে?
together.who.back: Who's here? What do you remember about this?

together.done_note.en: Talking about memories is good for the mind and the heart. There is no score here.
together.done_note.as: স্মৃতিৰ বিষয়ে কথা কোৱাটো মন আৰু হৃদয়ৰ বাবে ভাল। ইয়াত কোনো নম্বৰ নাই।
together.done_note.back: Talking about memories is good for the mind and heart. There is no number.

together.reject.en: I don't want to see this again
together.reject.back: I don't want to see this again

together.reject_confirm.en: Tap again to remove this forever
together.reject_confirm.as: ইয়াক চিৰকালৰ বাবে আঁতৰাবলৈ পুনৰ টিপি দিয়ক
together.reject_confirm.back: Press again to remove it forever

together.add_photos.en: A family member can add real photos and voice notes in the Memory Garden.
together.add_photos.as: পৰিয়ালৰ এজন সদস্যই মেম'ৰী গাৰ্ডেনত প্ৰকৃত ফটো আৰু ভইচ নোট যোগ দিব পাৰে।
together.add_photos.back: A family member can add actual photos and voice notes to the Memory Garden.

play.subtitle.en: Short, easy games. There are no wrong answers.
play.subtitle.as: চুটি, সহজ খেল। কোনো ভুল উত্তৰ নাই।
play.subtitle.back: Short, easy game. There is no wrong answer.

reminder.none.as: এতিয়ালৈকে কোনো ৰিমাইণ্ডাৰ কৰা হোৱা নাই

reminder.none_help.en: A family member or health worker can add medicine, water, activity and clinic reminders in Circle.
reminder.none_help.as: পৰিয়ালৰ এজন সদস্য বা স্বাস্থ্য কৰ্মচাৰীয়ে চক্ৰত ঔষধ, পানী, কাৰ্য্যকলাপ আৰু ক্লিনিক ৰিমাইণ্ডাৰ যোগ দিব পাৰে।
reminder.none_help.back: A family member or health worker can add medicine, water, activities, and clinic reminders to the cycle.

reminder.not_armed.en: Reminders are not set up on this phone.
reminder.not_armed.as: এই ফোনত ৰিমাইণ্ডাৰ আপ কৰা নাই।
reminder.not_armed.back: This phone does not have a reminder up.

reminder.all_done.en: All reminders are done for today.
reminder.all_done.as: আজিৰ বাবে সকলো ৰিমাইণ্ডাৰ কৰা হৈছে।
reminder.all_done.back: All reminders have been made for today.

today.nothing_yet.as: আজিও কোনো খেল খেলা হোৱা নাই।
today.nothing_yet.back: No games have been played to date.

home.circle.one.back: The person who cares for you
